# BLO-59228 — gzip oversized prompt Secrets

[BLO-59228](https://paperclip.blockcast.net/BLO/issues/BLO-59228) addresses Kubernetes rejecting an opencode_k8s prompt Secret with HTTP 422 `FieldValueTooLong` when the decoded `data` exceeded the 1 MiB Secret limit.

Files changed:
- `src/server/execute.ts`
- `src/server/execute.test.ts`
- `src/server/job-manifest.ts`
- `src/server/job-manifest.test.ts`

The adapter now gzip-encodes prompts above the Kubernetes Secret limit, stores the compressed bytes in `data["prompt.gz"]`, reconstructs the original prompt in the init container, and reports a bounded failure when compression still does not fit. Tests cover UTF-8 round-trip, incompressible oversized input, and init wiring.

Source: [Blockcast/paperclip#3875](https://github.com/Blockcast/paperclip/pull/3875)
